description: Claim-support cases for the Meridian Code Academy corpus. Four labels: SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, NOT_IN_DOCS (plausible but absent), PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (one part holds, another does not). A recurring twist for a coding school: a claim names the right rule but the wrong sanction tier.

cases.claim: Connection logs are retained for 6 months.
cases.label: SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: MCA-PRIV 3.2 states 6 months.

cases.claim: An API token is valid for 90 minutes.
cases.label: SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: MCA-API 3.2 sets token validity at 90 minutes.

cases.claim: A locker may be used for at most 72 hours.
cases.label: SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: MCA-RULES 5.1 caps locker use at 72 hours.

cases.claim: Exams last between 2 and 6 hours.
cases.label: SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: MCA-EXAM 4 states 2 to 6 hours.

cases.claim: The API secret is rotated once a year.
cases.label: CONTRADICTED
cases.rationale: MCA-API 3.2 rotates the secret every 14 days, not yearly.

cases.claim: A lost badge is replaced free of charge.
cases.label: CONTRADICTED
cases.rationale: MCA-RULES 3.3 charges EUR 8 then EUR 15.

cases.claim: Phones may be kept on silent during an exam as long as they stay in a pocket.
cases.label: CONTRADICTED
cases.rationale: MCA-EXAM 2 requires devices to be switched off and stored in the bag.

cases.claim: Alumni status triggers automatically after 12 months of inactivity.
cases.label: CONTRADICTED
cases.rationale: MCA-PROG 3.2 sets automatic transition at 6 months.

cases.claim: Students receive a free meal voucher every day.
cases.label: NOT_IN_DOCS
cases.rationale: No document mentions meal vouchers.

cases.claim: The API provides a GraphQL endpoint.
cases.label: NOT_IN_DOCS
cases.rationale: The API terms never mention GraphQL or any specific endpoint technology.

cases.claim: Students get a 40% discount at partner gyms.
cases.label: NOT_IN_DOCS
cases.rationale: No partner-gym discount is described anywhere.

cases.claim: The selection bootcamp includes a mandatory English-language test.
cases.label: NOT_IN_DOCS
cases.rationale: MCA-PROG 1.2 describes the bootcamp but says nothing about an English test.

cases.claim: Connection logs are kept for 6 months and backups are kept for 6 months.
cases.label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: Logs at 6 months is correct (3.2), but backups are 90 days (3.3), not 6 months.

cases.claim: An API token lasts 90 minutes and the rate limit is 5,000 requests per hour.
cases.label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: 90 minutes is correct, but the rate limit is 1,200 requests per hour per token, not 5,000.

cases.claim: Lockers may be used for up to 72 hours and food may be stored in them.
cases.label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: 72 hours is correct, but 5.1 forbids storing food in lockers.

cases.claim: A student who brings alcohol onto campus gets a 3-hour community-service penalty.
cases.label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: Bringing alcohol is indeed penalized, but it is a Tier 3 offense (Disciplinary Board, up to exclusion) under 7.3, not a 3-hour Tier 1 penalty under 7.1.

cases.claim: Audience cookies are stored for at most 13 months.
cases.label: SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: MCA-COOKIE 2 sets audience cookies at a maximum of 13 months.

cases.claim: Video-surveillance footage is kept for 6 months.
cases.label: CONTRADICTED
cases.rationale: MCA-CCTV 4 retains footage for 21 days, not 6 months.

cases.claim: The MCA website offers a dark-mode setting.
cases.label: NOT_IN_DOCS
cases.rationale: No document mentions a dark-mode or any UI theming setting.

cases.claim: CCTV cameras cover entrances and also record individual workstations.
cases.label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: Coverage of entrances is correct, but 2 states cameras are never positioned to view individual workstations.

cases.claim: An intranet password must be at least 12 characters long.
cases.label: SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: MCA-SITE 4.1 requires at least 12 characters.

cases.claim: An 8-character intranet password is acceptable.
cases.label: CONTRADICTED
cases.rationale: MCA-SITE 4.1 requires a minimum of 12 characters.

cases.claim: The intranet supports passwordless passkey login.
cases.label: NOT_IN_DOCS
cases.rationale: No document mentions passkeys or passwordless authentication.

cases.claim: An intranet password must be at least 12 characters and must contain a special character.
cases.label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
cases.rationale: The 12-character minimum is correct, but 4.1 requires an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a digit, not a special character.
